keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
First Half ends, Plymouth Parkway 0, Berkhamsted 0.
Goal! Plymouth Parkway 0, Berkhamsted 1. Luke Andrews (Berkhamsted) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jonathan Lacey with a through ball.
Substitution, Plymouth Parkway. Carlo Garside replaces Will Sullivan.
Substitution, Plymouth Parkway. Hayden Turner replaces Callum Hall.
Toby Down (Plymouth Parkway) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Luke Andrews (Berkhamsted).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Plymouth Parkway 1, Berkhamsted 1. Andrew Neal (Plymouth Parkway) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the high centre of the goal.
Substitution, Berkhamsted. Adam Watkins replaces Jonathan Lacey.
Substitution, Berkhamsted. Harry Rush replaces Cameron Hyde.
Substitution, Berkhamsted. Ruben Bartlett-Antwi replaces Jeffrey Sekyere.
Substitution, Berkhamsted. Godlove Oppong replaces James Gurteen.
Substitution, Plymouth Parkway. Edward Harrison replaces Ryan Brett.
Second Half ends, Plymouth Parkway 1, Berkhamsted 1.
Substitution, Berkhamsted. Connor Kurran-Browne replaces Ryan Blake.
Substitution, Berkhamsted. William Mardell-Smith replaces Jack Tompkins.
Adam Watkins (Berkhamsted) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Plymouth Parkway 2, Berkhamsted 1. Andrew Neal (Plymouth Parkway) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
First Half Extra Time ends, Plymouth Parkway 2, Berkhamsted 1.
Substitution, Plymouth Parkway. Henry Donovan replaces Reece Thomson.
Substitution, Plymouth Parkway. Joel Sullivan replaces Rio Garside.
Hayden Turner (Plymouth Parkway) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half Extra Time ends, Plymouth Parkway 2, Berkhamsted 1.
